accepted_gaps.statement: Dimensionality concepts are conflated across observation, compactification, and formal theory.
Observable limits are insufficiently tied to explicit compactification, warping, coupling, and EFT assumptions.
Cross-scale sensitivity and complementarity among laboratory, collider, GW, and cosmological channels remain difficult to audit.
Null results and theoretical consistency results are commonly over-interpreted beyond their declared scopes.
Candidate anomalies lack a shared alternative-explanation, replication, and cross-channel consistency protocol.
A theory can be currently compatible yet observationally unidentifiable; this status is not routinely separated from positive support.

rejected_gaps.statement: Experiments can measure the total number of dimensions without a theoretical model.
rejected_gaps.reason: No model-independent observable maps directly to that quantity.

rejected_gaps.statement: A null short-range-gravity test proves string theory false.
rejected_gaps.reason: It constrains only selected effective descriptions and scales.
